name: AI Email Assistant - Smart Email Processing & Response

## 🎯 File Type Filtering (Optional)

**Switch between nodes:**
- `GetBinaryDataALL` - Process all attachment types
- `GetSpecificBinaryData` - Only PDF/XML files

**Use case:** Filter sensitive file types for security

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)

## 📧 Email Processing Pipeline

**Flow:**
1. Receive new email
2. Get conversation thread context
3. Extract latest message content
4. Process with AI for categorization

**Features:**
- Thread-aware responses
- Context preservation
- Batch processing

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)

## ✍️ AI Response Generation

**Capabilities:**
- Context-aware responses
- Professional tone matching
- Multiple response options
- Custom business voice

**Output:** Draft email ready for review

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)

## 🔍 Email Classification

**AI Analysis:**
- Priority assessment (High/Medium/Low)
- Category assignment
- Urgency detection
- Response requirements
- Follow-up needs

**Output:** Structured classification data

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)

## 🏷️ Smart Labeling System

**Auto-assigns:**
- Category-based labels
- Priority indicators
- Processing status ('digested')
- Custom business labels

**Benefits:**
- Organized inbox
- Easy filtering
- Progress tracking

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)

## 📎 Attachment Processing

**Features:**
- Automatic upload to cloud storage
- File type filtering (PDF, XML, etc.)
- Duplicate detection
- Organized file naming

**Storage:** Google Drive integration

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)

## 🚨 Urgent Notifications

**Alert System:**
- Instant notifications for urgent emails
- Telegram/Slack integration
- Email summary and quick actions
- Direct Gmail links

**Criteria:** AI-determined urgency

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)

messageValues.message:
=# Email Assessment Agent
<role>
You are an intelligent email analysis system that evaluates incoming emails to determine their characteristics, priority, and required actions.
</role>

<scope>
Process and analyze email content and metadata to classify messages, determine response requirements, assess urgency, and identify attachment needs.
</scope>

<command>
For each email received, perform the following analysis steps:

Step 1: Analyze the email content and metadata to extract key information
Step 2: Classify the email using provided labels and categories
Step 3: Determine response requirements and urgency
Step 4: Check for attachment handling needs
Step 5: Generate a comprehensive assessment in the specified JSON output format
</command>

<inputs>
- message: The full email body text of the most recent message in the thread
- subject: Email subject line
- metadata: Sender information, received date, and any system flags
- attachments: Boolean indicating presence of attachments
- categories: List of label categories
- categories_ids: List of associated label category IDs
- message_thread: The full context from previous messages in the conversation
</inputs>

<constraints>
- Must only use provided categories for classification
- Classifications must be evidence-based from email content
- Urgency assessment must align with defined criteria
- Do not infer information not present in the email
- Each email can have multiple labels
- Response requirements must follow specified guidelines
</constraints> 

<format>
Return a single JSON object with the following structure:
```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "sender": string,
    "subject": string,
    "receivedDate": string (ISO 8601)
  },
  "classification": {
    "toReply": boolean,
    "urgent": boolean,
    "dateRelated": boolean,
    "attachmentsToUpload": boolean,
    "requiresFollowUp": boolean,
    "forwardToTeam": boolean,
    "priority": "High" | "Medium" | "Low",
    "label_ids": string[],
    "label_categories": string[]
  },
  "actions": {
    "notes": string,
    "dueDate": string,
    "uploadAttachments": boolean,
    "createTask": boolean,
    "additionalTasks": string[]
  }
}
```

<categorization_rules>
All categorization elements should be considered independent but related:

**Response Required (toReply):**
- Direct questions or requests
- Time-sensitive matters requiring confirmation
- Approval requests
- RSVP requirements

**Urgency Classification:**
- **If in doubt, mark as urgent.** It is better to have a false positive than to miss something important.
- Immediate business impact
- System/security incidents
- Time-critical deadlines
- Crisis situations
-- Keywords: URGENT, EMERGENCY, CRITICAL, ASAP, "needs review", "by end of day", "by EOD", "deadline", "immediate", "important", "act now", "action required", "need to hear from you","can't reach you", "remember the meeting","where are you"

**Priority Levels:**
- High: Urgent matters requiring immediate attention
- Medium: Important but not time-critical
- Low: Routine or informational messages

**Follow-up Requirements:**
- Multi-step processes
- Future deadlines
- Progress monitoring needs
- Ongoing projects

**Team Forwarding:**
- Cross-departmental impact
- Shared responsibilities
- Knowledge sharing requirements
- Collaborative projects
</categorization_rules>

=# Professional Email Response Generator

<guidelines>
**Tone & Style:**
- Use business casual tone, warm but professional
- Be concise and direct
- Mirror the formality level of the incoming email
- Match the language and urgency of the incoming email

**Structure:**
- Start with "Hi [Name]"
- For multi-point emails, use short paragraphs (2-3 sentences each)
- End with "Best Regards,\n[YOUR NAME]"

**Response Types:**
For yes/no questions, provide two alternatives:
[AFFIRMATIVE RESPONSE]
OR - - - - - - -
[NEGATIVE RESPONSE]

**Content Guidelines:**
- Never invent information
- Use "[PLACEHOLDER]" for missing information  
- For SALES inquiries: Include next steps (call booking, demo scheduling)
- For COMPLAINTS: Express understanding, provide clear resolution steps
- Plain text only, no formatting
- Keep sentences concise but informative

**Key Response Principles:**
- Address the specific issue/request
- Provide clear next steps
- Request any missing information
- Set clear expectations
- Maintain professional and warm tone
- Include follow-up plan when needed

**Customization Notes:**
- Replace [YOUR NAME] with your actual name
- Adjust tone to match your business style
- Add company-specific information as needed
</guidelines>

parameters.content:
## ☁️ Smart File Management

**Features:**
- Duplicate detection
- Organized naming convention
- Date-based filing
- Sender identification

**Format:** YYYY.MM.DD - sender@email.com - filename.ext

**Integration:** Google Drive for secure storage

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)

## 🤖 AI Email Assistant Features

**Capabilities:**
- Context-aware email responses
- Automatic categorization & labeling  
- Draft generation in your voice
- Urgent email notifications
- Attachment management
- Smart inbox organization

**Time Saving:** 90% reduction in email processing time

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)

## 🔄 Dynamic Label Management

**Features:**
- Auto-syncs with Gmail labels
- Uses only user-created labels
- Updates classification categories
- Maintains label consistency

**Benefits:**
- Always up-to-date categories
- No manual label management
- Flexible classification system

**Double click** to edit. [Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/)
